name: Medication Dispensed
sourceRefs: usnistgov/tcamt-2 tcamt-lite-controller/SCRIPT_XML_10_6.xsd (NIST-hosted, RxFillDispensedMedicationType, ~line 2915) -- a real, official-provenance NCPDP SCRIPT XSD, but for the OLDER SCRIPT v10.6 wire format, not the v2017071 this engine otherwise targets. No free v2017071 schema/sample containing RxFill exists (unlike NewRx); this is the best available structural cross-reference, used the same way cosyte/ncpdp was used for the lifecycle transactions -- a real, sourced shape, not an invention.

Core fields only (DrugDescription/DrugCoded/Quantity/WrittenDate/LastFillDate) -- the full RxFillDispensedMedicationType also carries DaysSupply, Directions, Note, Refills, Substitutions, ExpirationDate, EffectiveDate, PeriodEnd, DeliveredOnDate, DateValidated, SoldDate, Diagnosis, PriorAuthorization, DrugUseEvaluation, DrugCoverageStatusCode, PriorAuthorizationStatus, StructuredSIG -- deliberately deferred, matching this engine's own established 'core fields, not exhaustive' precedent (e.g. EDI 835/837's own scope notes).
